## Documentation

A Phone Contact to be added in your Telegram address book.
It is intended to be used with `add_contacts()`

### Parameters

- **`phone`** (`str`)
  Contact's phone number

- **`first_name`** (`str`)
  Contact's first name

- **`last_name`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Contact's last name
